_comment: Evaluation parameters the committee sets at the analysis stage (not seen by respondents). The form in notebook 07 is generated from this file: add, remove or reword a parameter here, not in code. null default = not yet decided; analyses that need such a value say so instead of guessing. Form trigger thresholds stay in src/config/clusters.json, since they decide which questions respondents see.

parameters.label: Availability
parameters.help: Share of the year a cluster's nodes are up and accepting jobs, after planned maintenance, power shutdowns, outages and nodes out of service. 0.95 is about 18 days down a year. The hardware check asks the convener for planned downtime; Slurm accounting (sreport) can measure it.

parameters.label: Usable share of available time
parameters.help: Share of the available core-hours that can be kept busy while queue waits stay reasonable. Jobs never fill the nodes perfectly, and on a shared cluster waits grow steeply once it is more than about 80–85 % busy. 0.85 is a common planning value; the past year's measured utilisation (Slurm accounting) is a check on it. Deliverable capacity = cores × 8,760 h × availability × this share.

parameters.label: Largest scratch area per user
parameters.help: Scratch is shared and purged; this is the most one user may hold at once.

parameters.label: Home-area guide per group
parameters.help: A guide value for comparing each group's reported home use, not a quota.

parameters.label: Candidate queue table

columns.help: jobs one group may have running at once in this queue
blank for compute nodes; highmem or gpu
nodes all groups together may use in this queue; blank = no ceiling
jobs all groups together may run in this queue; blank = no ceiling

parameters.help: One queue per line, values separated by commas, in the column order shown. Compute queues share one pool of nodes, so the two ceilings at the end (all groups together) and the per-group job limit are what a queue design sets. Leave empty to compare against the present queues only.

parameters.label: Annual revenue target
parameters.help: The amount the facility is asked to recover from usage charges in a year.

parameters.label: Share of groups receiving the free annual allowance
parameters.help: Which groups receive it is decided by the committee and the institute; the analysis uses only this share and never infers it from the answers.

parameters.label: Free annual allowance per group (CPU)
parameters.help: Standard-queue CPU usage free of charge each year for a group receiving the allowance.

parameters.label: Free annual allowance per group (GPU)
parameters.help: Leave empty if the allowance covers CPU only.

parameters.label: Premium charge multiple
parameters.help: Charge for premium queues relative to the standard queue. Compare with the multiples groups reported in Section H.
